bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
stage="$root/.worktrees/bug-report-f173f8e-20261115"
test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = f173f8e86d1abb0eb105251261cfc0b31dc2f954 || exit 60
container="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -E '(^|[-_])gaybbs([-_]|$)' | head -n1)"
test -n "$container" || exit 61
project="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' "$container")"
old="$(docker compose -p "$project" --project-directory "$root/deploy" -f "$stage/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" exec -T postgres psql -U gace -d gaybbs -t -A -c "SELECT message_id FROM board_menu_panels WHERE chat_id=-1003770334893 AND panel_type='posting' AND state='verified' AND message_id>0 AND message_thread_id>0" 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^[0-9]+$' || true)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$old" | grep -Ec '^[0-9]+$')" -eq 1 || exit 62
override="$(mktemp /tmp/gace-gay-publish-override.XXXXXXXX.yaml)"
log="$(mktemp /tmp/gace-gay-publish.XXXXXXXX)"
chmod 600 "$override" "$log"
trap 'rm -f "$override" "$log"' EXIT
printf 'services:\n  gaybbs:\n    image: gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:bugreport-f173f8e\n' >"$override"
docker compose -p "$project" --project-directory "$root/deploy" -f "$stage/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" -f "$override" run --rm --no-deps -e MENU_PUBLISH_PANEL_TYPES=posting -e MENU_PUBLISH_CHAT_ID=-1003770334893 gaybbs node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs /app/publishMenuPanels.mjs >"$log" 2>&1 || exit 63
python3 - "$log" "$old" <<'PY'
import json,sys
rows=[]
for line in open(sys.argv[1]):
 try:x=json.loads(line)
 except (ValueError,TypeError):continue
 if x.get("panel_type")=="posting":rows.append(x)
if not(len(rows)==1 and int(rows[0]["chat_id"])==-1003770334893 and int(rows[0]["message_id"])==int(sys.argv[2]) and rows[0]["updated_existing"] is True):sys.exit(64)
print("GAY_POSTING_PANEL_IN_PLACE=PASS")
PY
count="$(docker compose -p "$project" --project-directory "$root/deploy" -f "$stage/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" exec -T postgres psql -U gace -d gaybbs -t -A -c "SELECT count(*) FROM board_menu_panels WHERE chat_id=-1003770334893 AND panel_type='posting' AND state='published' AND message_id=$old" 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^[0-9]+$' | head -n1)"
test "$count" = 1 || exit 65
echo GAY_POSTING_PANEL_RECONCILED=PASS
